cont.description: Set to true to read progress continuously from command’s stdout (e.g., with tail -f). Cannot be used with 'interval'.

down.description: Set to true if progress value decreases during execution (e.g., file deletion). If set, default start is 'initial'.

interval.description: Seconds between invocations of the progress command. Cannot be used with 'cont' option.

start.description: Starting value (0% progress). Supports metric/binary suffixes (k,m,g,t,ki,mi,gi,ti) or 'initial' to use first value from progress command.

width.description: Width (columns) of the eta output. Defaults to terminal width if not specified and stdout is a TTY.
